51591635.protein: BUB3-interacting and GLEBS motif-containing protein ZNF207
51591635.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human ZNF207 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: ZNF207 Direct Binding Analysis. Direct interaction of TML001 and C16 with ZNF207 was investigated by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis. ZNF207 was directly immobilized on a CMS sensor chip and probed with increasing amounts of TML001 or C16. The resulting SPR sensorgrams (Figures 5A,B and S1) showed a direct interaction between synthesized compounds and ZNF207. The equilibrium dissociation constant value was 67 nM for C16, outperforming the virtual screened hit TML001 (2.4 μM). To further confirm the target engagement in H4 and U251MG cells, we conducted the cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) using C16, following the methods outlined in the materials and methods section. The results, depicted in Figure 5C–F, demonstrate that C16 increased the melting temperature (Tm) of ZNF207 by approximately 1.9 °C at a concentration of 30 μM in H4 cells when compared to the DMSO vehicle. In U251MG cells, C16 exhibited a greater thermal stabilization effect on ZNF207, with a shift in Tm of approximately 5.2 °C (~48.7 °C to ~53.9 °C, Figure 5). These CETSA findings suggest that C16 has the ability to directly bind to endogenous ZNF207.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. Direct binding of C16 to ZNF207 in glioma cells. SPR analysis of TML001 (A) and C16 (B) binding to immobilized ZNF207. Increasing concentrations of TML001 (1.5625–25 μM) or C16 (19.5–625 nM) diluted in running buffer were injected over a ZNF207-immobilized CMS sensor chip. Kd, equilibrium dissociation constant and RU, response unit. Representative CETSA bolt for the binding of C16 to H4 (C) and U251MG (D) cell lysates. Thermal denaturation curves for H4 (E) and U251MG (F) cell lysates in the presence of 30 μM C16 or 0.1% (V/V) dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO). The relative band intensities from the Western blot analysis were calculated based on the lowest temperature (30 °C). Representative results from three independent replicates were shown, and the error bars indicated mean ± SD. Tm, Melting temperature.
original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Analysis: ZNF207 Direct Binding Analysis. Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Analysis. The binding affinity of the compounds to ZNF207 was determined using a Biacore T200 with a CMS sensor chip (Cytiva, Washington, DC). Briefly, 40 μg/mL hZNF207 (in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS), pH 7.5) was immobilized onto the sensor chip previously activated with a 1 min pulse of 10 mM NaAC (pH 4.5). The first flow cell was used as a reference surface to control nonspecific binding. Both flow cells were injected with the analyte (in PBS-P, 5% DMSO, pH 7.5) at a flow rate of 30 μL/min at 25 °C in increasing concentrations. The data were analyzed with Biacore Evaluation software. Kd values were calculated by global fitting of the equilibrium binding responses from various concentrations of analytes using a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
